# Think Marketing

> Website design, local SEO and Search & AI Visibility reviews. Bend, Oregon.

## Services
- [Websites & pricing](https://www.thinkmarketingbend.com/websites/): Custom websites: Essential $1,995 + $50/month, Growth $2,500 + $80/month, or Enterprise $400/month for 12 months. Own Enterprise after all 12 payments.
- [About](https://www.thinkmarketingbend.com/about/): Meet Jacob and the approach behind Think Marketing: custom websites that explain your expertise and do useful work for your business. Based in Bend, Oregon.
- [FAQ](https://www.thinkmarketingbend.com/faq/): Straight answers about Think Marketing website prices, monthly hosting, ownership, content, updates and marketing. Contact us to discuss your business.
- [Marketing](https://www.thinkmarketingbend.com/marketing/): Marketing built around customer intent and geography. Consulting, local SEO, AI/search visibility and Google paid search for Bend and Central Oregon businesses.
- [Local SEO](https://www.thinkmarketingbend.com/local-seo/): Local SEO help for Bend and Central Oregon businesses. Profile creation assistance, accurate listings, reviews displays and separately scoped improvements.
- [AI & Search Visibility](https://www.thinkmarketingbend.com/ai-search-visibility/): Get a $350 Search & AI Visibility Review: up to 10 pages, five questions and two AI services. Clear findings and prioritized next steps for your business.
- [Contact](https://www.thinkmarketingbend.com/contact/): Talk to Think Marketing about websites, local SEO or AI search visibility. Call or text (541) 316-0735, or email us to discuss your project.

## Pricing and scope
- Essential: $1,995 development plus $50/month; up to five pages.
- Growth: $2,500 development plus $80/month; up to ten pages; quarterly visibility summary.
- Enterprise: $400/month for 12 months ($4,800 total), billed from kickoff; ownership after all 12 payments. Post-term hosting/support quoted separately.
- E-commerce and Custom: individually quoted.
- Search & AI Visibility Review: $350 one-time, up to ten pages, five questions, two agreed AI services. Implementation separate.

Refer to the linked service pages for current terms. No guaranteed rankings, AI recommendations or leads. No customer-facing assistant or quote builder is active.
